reuse: Cargo dependencies only; no copied server/JVM implementation code
provenance: Pinned crates.io artifacts; license/repository metadata inspected from downloaded package Cargo.toml; checksums retained in isolated Cargo.lock. No dependencies added to root workspace.
benchmark: Not a runtime performance integration. Correctness campaign compares every generated V2 fixture and all preserved Clean Forge/Revelation transformed class inputs.
semantic_differences: cafebabe MemberRef erases interface reference kind; bounded raw CP-tag supplement retains it
cafebabe type annotation representation erases some target tags; bounded raw tag supplement retains them
cafebabe access flag types truncate unknown bits; bounded raw access supplement retains bits
ASM 5 adds Synthetic annotation markers for omitted leading parameters; exact count-checked inversion documented in README
Unused CP/bootstrap entries excluded from cross-check projection; retained by authoritative V2 identity
No JVM execution, dataflow verification or live profile qualification is claimed
integration_complexity: Moderate, isolated CLI and Python fact projection. Unknown attributes and unsupported versions/strings reject.
notice_policy: No copyleft code copied. Before redistributing standalone binaries include notices from selected licensed dependency artifacts. 0BSD imposes no notice retention condition; provenance remains recorded.
